verdict.rationale: Reflect documents an OAuth2/PKCE REST API with an OpenAPI spec on openpm. Its write side is real: POST /graphs/{graphId}/notes creates notes and PUT /daily-notes appends to them, so an agent can write headlessly. Reading is not possible, because the docs state that end-to-end encrypted note contents can't be served by the API; an agent can only list graphs, bookmarked links and user info. Missing for 10: API read access to note contents, an MCP server or local API, versioning/deprecation policy or sandbox, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.
